defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab10_ti: How many times can I win in Kwizz and Tell?
defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab1_mes:
a. ‘Kwizz and Tell’ is an exciting quiz interactivity designed for Koffee with Karan enthusiasts. This innovative feature enhances your favorite show by providing viewers with an interactive platform to flaunt their knowledge of the show.
b. All logged-in viewers can participate in the ‘Kwizz and Tell’ quiz. 
c. Viewers are allowed to take part in the 'Kwizz and Tell’ once per account every day.
d. ‘Kwizz and Tell’ Quiz will run till January 24th, 2024.
defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab1_tit: What is ‘Kwizz and Tell’ and who can participate in it?
defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab2_mes: Viewers can respond to 5 questions everyday in the ‘Kwizz and Tell’. Each question is fact-based, allowing viewers to express their knowledge about the show.
defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab2_tit: What type of questions are in the ‘Kwizz and Tell’ Quiz?
defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab3_mes: When a viewer encounters a question they're unsure of, simply clicking the 'Watch Hint' button redirects them to the specific Koffee with Karan episode, offering them the opportunity to discover the answer.
defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab3_tit: What does the ‘Watch Hint’ button do?
defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab4_mes:
a. Viewers receive 20 points for answering each question correctly between Question No. 1 to Question No. 4
b. Viewers receive 40 points for answering the Bumper question (Question No. 5) correctly.
c. Viewers do not receive any points for incorrect answer
d. Bonus points are earned for daily participation (10 points multiplied by the days played).
i. Eg: If the viewer participated in the quiz for the 5th time in the season, then the viewer will get 50 bonus points on the 5th day of participation
e. Additional 100 points are granted for sharing ‘Kwizz and Tell’ results with friends
defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab4_tit: How are points awarded in the ‘Kwizz and Tell’ Quiz?
defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab5_mes:
a. There are two types of leaderboards: the Weekly leaderboard and the Season leaderboard.
i. The Weekly leaderboard ranks viewers based on their points earned during a week, from quiz participation and for sharing of quiz results with friends (excluding bonus points). The week runs from Thursday to Wednesday.
ii. The Season leaderboard ranks viewers based on their cumulative points earned from the beginning of the season until January 24th, 2024. This includes points from quiz participation, sharing of quiz results with friends, and bonus points.
defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab5_tit: What are the different types of leaderboard?
defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab6_mes:
a. In the event of a tie, the tiebreaker is determined by the higher watch time of any/all episodes of Koffee with Karan from Season 1 to Season 8, available on the Disney+ Hotstar Application by the viewer. The specific criteria will vary for the Weekly and Season leaderboards:
i. For the Weekly leaderboard, watch time during the respective week serves as the tiebreaker.
ii. For the Season leaderboard, watch time from the start of the season until January 24th, 2024, acts as the tiebreaker.

ii. For the Season leaderboard, watch time from the start of the season until January 24th, 2024, acts as the tiebreaker.
defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab6_tit: How is the ranking done between the viewers who have the same score?
defaultStringStore.common-v2__webView_quiz_KWK_FAQ_tab7_mes:

The individuals who give the right answers for all the questions will be shortlisted and 10 people will be selected randomly by the audit committee.
